depiction.primary_object: upward-pointing arrow with a dashed tail
modifiers: dashed tail segments at the bottom

ambiguity: Barely distinguishable from a plain up arrow; the dashed tail is pure UI chrome (move up, scroll up, push) and carries no concrete subject of its own.

modifier_semantics.meaning: motion trail, incremental movement upward, or origin point

reasoning: An upward arrow with a dashed tail is generic directional UI chrome (move up, scroll, push/upload) rather than a concrete object or distinct subject. In a task list, almost any task involving uploading, upgrading, or raising something has a far more specific noun (document, server, cloud, money) that makes a better icon.
